inputs.text: [excited] Dye… loh… foh… saurus. [curious] "Di" means two in Greek. "Lopho" means a crest. [playful] And "saurus" means the…
[hesitant] Wait, let me guess: the two-crested lizard.
[happily] Got it! Two crests standing up on its head. [confident] It lived in North America, [amazed] one hundred ninety-three million years ago — one of the very first big hunters in history.
[playful] Like a party crown. [amazed] Probably very colorful, made to be noticed.
